user.title: Set up Zeitarchiv
user.description: Connection to a Zeitarchiv add-on. Multiple named destinations can run in parallel, for example production and test. Find the API token in the add-on's settings.

reconfigure.title: Zeitarchiv – Update connection
reconfigure.description: Update host/port/token — e.g. if the token was regenerated or cleared in the add-on's settings ("Connection" section).

reauth_confirm.title: Zeitarchiv – Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on rejected the stored API token — it was probably regenerated or cleared in the add-on's settings ("Connection" section). Enter the new token.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the add-on. Is it running and is the port reachable?
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected the API token.

init.title: Zeitarchiv – Settings
init.description: Edit archive filters or safely transfer them between Home Assistant systems.

menu_option_descriptions.filters: Select domains, entities, areas, devices, patterns, and exclusions.
menu_option_descriptions.overview: Review included, stateless, and excluded entities.
menu_option_descriptions.export: Copy the current filters without host or API token.
menu_option_descriptions.import: Read a Zeitarchiv export and replace the current filters.

filters.title: Zeitarchiv – Archive filters
filters.description: Coarse selection of what gets archived at all. Resolution/retention (including the defaults for newly detected entities) are set in the Zeitarchiv UI itself (Settings → Archiving).

data_description.entity_patterns: One pattern per line. Patterns without a dot match the object ID (`*_power`); patterns with a dot match the full entity ID (`sensor.weather_*`). `*` and `?` are supported.
data_description.exclude_entity_patterns: One pattern per line. Exclusions always take precedence, for example `*_id` or `sensor.*_raw`.
data_description.decimal_places: How many decimal places sensor values are rounded to before transmission (0–3). Recommended: 3 (default) — fits practically all sensors. Fewer decimal places improve compressibility of the add-on's long-term storage and can save some disk space, which may become noticeable with many entities and long retention. Too few decimal places, however, can lose accuracy for fine-grained readings (e.g. current in A).

export.title: Zeitarchiv – Export filters
export.description: Copy the YAML content and save it as a file, or paste it into “Import filters from YAML” on another system. Host and API token are not included. Select “Submit” to return to the menu.

import.title: Zeitarchiv – Import filters
import.description: Paste a previously exported Zeitarchiv YAML document. Importing replaces all current filters. Areas and devices only work if their internal IDs match on this system.
